g.text: Equal-count quintiles of gene length, so length cannot drive a within-panel difference
Mark fold change inside gene-length quintiles
Positive means neuronal genes carry the higher log2FC in that quintile
Rank-biserial correlation, neuronal against other, inside each quintile
Gene length does not explain the neuronal chromatin response
